name: Dragon Scale Mail
description: A coat of red dragon scales, each as large as a hand, warm to the touch.
body:
## What it does

The scales of one dragon, fitted into scale mail. It guards better than plain scale, steadies you against a dragon's breath and dread, and wards against the element of the dragon it came from. These are red scales, so it wards against fire.

## Dragon sense

Once a day, as an action, you can sense the direction and distance of the nearest dragon of the same kind within 30 miles.

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against the frightful presence and breath weapons of dragons

features.name: Dragon Sense
features.text: Once per dawn, as an action, learn the distance and direction to the nearest red dragon within 30 miles.
